tool_suggestions.title: API Usage Insights Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create a dashboard to provide detailed insights into API usage patterns, helping ops and engineering teams optimize resource allocation.
features: View total monthly API requests per organization
Filter requests by status code and response time
Visualize top endpoints and query types by request volume
Generate exportable reports of usage trends

tool_suggestions.title: User Permissions & Access Manager
tool_suggestions.prompt: Develop a tool to manage and audit user roles and permissions across organizations, ensuring proper access control and compliance.
features: List and edit user roles within each organization
Audit log view of permission changes over time
Export user access reports for compliance review
Set automated alerts for unauthorized role changes

tool_suggestions.title: Subscription Renewal & Alert System
tool_suggestions.prompt: Build a system to monitor subscription statuses and send alerts for upcoming renewals, supporting the sales team in retention efforts.
features: Dashboard view of upcoming subscription renewals
Automated email alerts for renewals and expirations
Search and filter subscriptions by organization and plan
